inlines.v: DISUSE, noun Disyuse. [dis and use.] 1. Cessation of use, practice or exercise; as, the limbs lose their strength and pliability by disuse; language is altered by the disuse of words. 2. Cessation of custom; desuetude. DISUSE, verb transitive disyuze. [dis and use.] 1. To cease to use; to neglect or omit to practice. 2. To disaccustom; with from, in or to; as disused to toils; disused from pain.
